items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, a lot of guys played there. Hawkins did.

ctx.x: You were like -- say in the first year -- you had your band with Billie Berg's (PHONETIC) and (inaudible) and that's a place that's become famous because Dizzy and Berg played there you know like the first time they did --
Yeah, a lot of guys played there. Hawkins did. I don't know for sure that Louis didn't play there. I'm not sure.
With a big band I guess at that
